32200 series tapered roller bearings. Wider and has higher load capacity than the 30200 series. Suitable for heavy combined radial-axial loads. Used in automotive differentials, industrial reducers, and conveyor systems.
51200 series thrust ball bearings. Wider and has higher axial load capacity than the 51100 series. Carries one-way axial load. Used in screw presses, rotary tables, and vertical shaft applications.
7300 series angular contact ball bearings. 40 degree contact angle. Higher load capacity than the 7200 series. Ideal for heavy combined loads. Used in pumps, compressors, and machine tools.

7300 serisi acisal temasli bilyali rulmanlar. 40 derece temas acisi. 7200 serisine gore daha yuksek yuk kapasitesi. Agir kombine yukler icin idealdir. Pompa, kompresor ve takim tezgahlarinda kullanilir.

AWS A5.1 classification example for Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW): E7018. E = Electrode, 70 = tensile strength (70,000 psi / 480 MPa), 1 = All positions (Flat, Horizontal, Vertical, Overhead), 8 = Coating type (Low hydrogen, potassium/iron powder).

Acisal temasli bilyali rulmanlar (Angular Contact Ball Bearings). Temas acisi 40 derece. Yuksek aksiyel ve radyal kombine yuklere uygun. Genellikle ciftli (tandem, O veya X duzeni) monte edilir. Takim tezgahlari ve pompalar icin idealdir.

Acisal temaslı bilyalı rulmanlar (Angular Contact Ball Bearings). Temas acisi 40 derece. Yuksek aksiyel ve radyal kombine yuklere uygun. Genellikle çiftli (tandem, O veya X duzeni) monte edilir. Takim tezgâhları ve pompalar icin idealdir.
Aerospace-grade high-strength aluminum. Non-weldable. Usage: Aircraft structures, precision parts.

American Unified screw thread system. 60 degree thread angle. UNC: Unified National Coarse. UNF: Unified National Fine. UNEF: extra fine thread. Dimensions are in inches, pitch is expressed in threads/inch.
Angular contact ball bearings. 40 degree contact angle. Suitable for high combined axial and radial loads. Generally mounted in pairs (tandem, O or X arrangement). Ideal for machine tools and pumps.
Approximate belt length calculation formula for a system with two pulleys.
Area and volume formulas for basic geometric shapes.
Basic AGMA/ISO terms for spur gears. Module (m) is the standard for metric gears. Formula: Pitch circle diameter (d) = Module (m) * Number of teeth (z).
Basic meanings of weld symbols used in technical drawings. The symbol "below" the reference line represents the Arrow Side, and the symbol "above" represents the Other Side.
Basic thread profiles used in threading operations. Metric (M), Unified (UN), Whitworth (W), Parallel Pipe (G), Taper Pipe (R/BSPT), NPT, and Trapezoidal (Tr) thread types are available.
Bolt classes according to ISO 898-1. First digit: tensile strength/100. Second digit: yield/tensile ratio*10. E.g., 8.8 -> 800 MPa tensile, 80% yield ratio = 640 MPa yield.
Bolt tensile and shear stress calculations.

British Whitworth standard. 55 degree thread angle, rounded thread root profile. Although an old British standard, it is still used in some applications. BSW (coarse thread) and BSF (fine thread) versions are available.
Buckling strength of slender rods under pressure. K changes according to support conditions.
Calculation of frictional pressure drop in pipe flow.

Calculation of helical compression springs. Wire diameter (d), Mean coil diameter (D), Spring index (C = D/d). Stiffness: k = (G * d^4) / (8 * D^3 * N_a). The Wahl factor (K_w), which includes shear and curvature effects, is added to the shear stress formula.

Calculation of principal stresses and maximum shear stress in a 2D stress state. On Mohr's circle, σ₁, σ₂ principal stresses are read on the horizontal axis, τ_max at the highest point on the vertical axis.

Calculation of the elongated part while bending sheet metal in press brakes (Unfolded Length). K-Factor indicates the amount of shift of the material's neutral axis. For general steels, the industry standard is between K = 0.33 and 0.44.
Calculation of torsion stress and torsion angle in circular cross-sections.
Common bearing types and application areas. Deep groove, angular contact, cylindrical roller, tapered roller, needle roller, and spherical plain bearing types are available.
Crushing and shearing check in shaft-key joints.
Cylindrical roller bearings. Very high radial load capacity. Does not carry axial load (NU type). Inner and outer rings can be separated. Ideal for gearboxes, electric motors, rolling mills.
Dis byklg olcusu (Standart seriler: 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 ...)
Düşük hidrojen, ağır şase ve çatlak riski
En güvenli (muhafazakar) teori. Akma çizgisine sınırlar.
En yuksek yuk kapasiteli sabit bilyali rulman serisi. Buyuk bilyalar ve genis kesit. Agir endustriyel uygulamalar, maden makineleri, cimento ve kagit fabrikalari icin uygundur.

European standard I-beam dimensions and cross-sectional values. The cross-sectional view of the IPE profile is defined by h (height), b (flange width), tw (web thickness), tf (flange thickness), and r (fillet radius).
European standard U profile (NPU) dimensions and section values. The center of gravity (ey) is outside the web.
Eşdeğer gerilme, distorsiyon enerjisi akma enerjisini aştığında akma başlar.
Formulas for a beam fixed (embedded) at one end.
Formulas for a beam supported at both ends. Moment and deflection formulas for point load, distributed load, and triangular distributed loads.
Formulas for the three basic heat transfer mechanisms.
General-purpose structural steel. Weldability: Very good. Usage: Structural steel, profiles, pipes.
Geometrik Boyutlandirma ve Toleranslandirma (GD&T), imalatta parca geometrisini kontrol etmek icin kullanilan sistemdir.
High-strength structural steel. Weldability: Good. Usage: Bridges, cranes, pressure vessels.

Hole-basis fit system (H system). H7/g6: Sliding fit (clearance). H7/k6: Transition fit (near zero). H7/p6: Interference fit (press fit). Tolerance zone color coding: green=clearance, yellow=transition, red=interference.
ISO Metric screw thread. 60 degree thread angle. Symbol: M (dia x pitch). Example: M30 = 30mm dia, 3.5mm standard pitch. Fine pitch versions are also available.

ISO tolerances used when mounting the inner ring to the shaft and the outer ring to the housing. The rotating ring should have an interference fit, while the stationary ring should have a clearance/sliding fit.
Iki kasnakli bir sistemde yaklasik kayis boyu hesaplama formul.
Iki veya daha fazla parcacigin eksen kacagi

Ingiliz Whitworth standardi. 55 derece dis aisi, yuvarlak dis dibi profili. Eski Ingiliz standardi olmasina ragmen bazi uygulamalarda hl kullanilir. BSW (kaba dis) ve BSF (ince dis) versiyonlari mevcuttur.

Inner (shaft) and outer diameter references for the most widely used deep groove ball bearings in the industry (e.g., SKF 6000 series). Last two digits * 5 = Inner diameter (for 20mm and above). E.g., 6204 = 04 * 5 = 20mm inner diameter.

Kendinden ayarli (self-aligning) bilyali rulmanlar. Iki sira bilya, kuresel dis bilezik yolu. +-2 eksen sapmasini (misalignment) kompanse eder. Uzun mil uygulamalari, tarim ve tekstil makinelerinde kullanilir.

Kuresel makarali rulmanlar (Spherical Roller Bearings). Iki sira fici sekilli makara, kuresel dis bilezik yolu. Cok yuksek radyal yuk kapasitesi. +-2 eksen sapmasini kompanse eder. Agir endustriyel uygulamalar, konveyor, kirici, fan, disli kutusu ve kagit makinelerinde yaygin kullanilir.
Kırılma (Ultimate) çizgisine gider. Daha az muhafazakar.

Lead screw thread with a 30 degree trapezoidal profile. Designed for high axial force transmission. Used in screw presses, CNC machines, lifting mechanisms, and door/cover mechanisms. DIN 103 standard.
Lewis formula calculates the bending stress at the tooth root. F_t: Tangential force, b: Face width, Y: Lewis form factor. Formula: sigma = F_t / (b * m * Y)
Medium carbon quench and temper steel. Hardenable. Usage: Shafts, gears, pins, bolts.
Mil boyunca hareket edildigindeki toplam salgi
Mil donerken 1 turdaki eksenel kacagi (Salgi)
Moment of inertia values depending on cross-section geometry.
Most common structural aluminum. Excellent weldability and corrosion resistance.

NJ type cylindrical roller bearings. Outer ring with two flanges, inner ring with one flange. Carries both radial and unidirectional axial loads. Offers axial locating capability. Preferred in gearbox, electric motor, and fan applications.
Needle roller bearings. Compact design with very low radial cross-section height. High radial load capacity. Preferred for oscillating movements and limited space applications.
Nominal life calculation according to ISO 281. Bearings consist of inner ring, outer ring, balls, and cage. Life calculation depends on the ratio of dynamic load capacity (C) to equivalent load (P).
Physical constants commonly used in engineering.
S = Yield Strength / Working Stress. Static loads: S = 1.5-2.0. Dynamic loads: S = 2.0-3.0. Impact loads: S = 3.0-5.0.
SAE/AISI steel classification system. The first two digits indicate the alloy group, the last two digits the carbon percentage (x100).

SKF brand deep groove ball bearings. It's the most common bearing type. High speed capacity, low friction, carries both radial and axial loads. Available in sealed (2RS/2Z) and open versions.
Self-aligning ball bearings. Two rows of balls, spherical outer ring raceway. Compensates for up to +-2 degrees of misalignment. Used in long shaft applications, agricultural and textile machinery.

Spherical roller bearings. Two rows of barrel-shaped rollers, spherical outer ring raceway. Very high radial load capacity. Compensates for up to +-2 degrees of misalignment. Widely used in heavy industrial applications, conveyors, crushers, fans, gearboxes, and paper machines.
Spur gear geometry and strength calculation. Pitch circle, addendum circle, and dedendum circle dimensions are calculated based on module (m) during the meshing of two gears.
Standard DKP and black sheet metal thickness measurements frequently used in the industry and approximate weights for 1 m^2 plate (7.85 g/cm^3).
Standard Sheet Metal Thicknesses and Weights
Standard asynchronous electric motors (IEC standards). H = Shaft axis height.
Standard dimensions for classical V-belts and narrow V-belts for general industrial use.
Standard steel pipe dimensions (DIN 2440/2441).
Stress (σ): Force per unit area. Strain (ε): Unit elongation. Typical stress-strain curve for steel includes elastic region, yield point, strain hardening, and fracture stages.
Stress calculations for fillet and butt welds.
Surface roughness Ra values and processing methods to achieve them.
Sünek malzemelerdeki yorulma deneylerine en yakın eğri.
Sünek ve gevrek malzemelerin 3 eksenli kompleks gerilme altında akmasını (veya kırılmasını) öngören teoriler.
Tap drill size table for metric standard (M) screws. Formula: Drill diameter = Thread diameter - Pitch (d = D - P). Data is optimized for 75% thread depth for shop floor manufacturing operations.
Tapered roller bearings. Carries both radial and axial combined loads. Separable structure. Ideal for wheel hubs, gearbox reducers, conveyor rollers. Generally used in pairs.
The 2200 series is wider and has higher load capacity than the 1200 series self-aligning ball bearings. Uses larger balls. Preferred for heavy load and misalignment conditions.

The 23200 series spherical roller bearings are wider and have higher load capacity than the 22200 series. Designed for heavy shock loads and vibration conditions. Preferred for mining, steel industry, large fans, and crushing machinery.
The 6000 series is narrower and lighter than the 6200 series. Suitable for low-medium loads and compact applications. Provides high speed capacity.
The 6300 series has higher load capacity than the 6200 series. Uses wider and larger balls. Suitable for heavy loading conditions.
The highest load capacity deep groove ball bearing series. Large balls and wide cross-section. Suitable for heavy industrial applications, mining machinery, cement and paper mills.
Thin section deep groove ball bearings. Compact design with very low radial cross-section height. Ideal for robot wrists, optical devices, medical equipment, and precision measuring instruments.

Thread types used in pipe connections. G (BSP Parallel): Non-sealing connections, requires a gasket. R/BSPT (Taper): 1:16 taper, provides a sealed connection. NPT: American standard, 1:16 taper, 60 degree thread angle.
Thrust ball bearings. Carries one-way axial load. Does not carry radial load. Low-medium speed applications. Ideal for vertical shafts, screw presses, rotary tables.

Titreşimli veya periyodik değişken gerilmelere maruz kalan hareketli parçaların (miller, krank gibi) sonsuz ömür dizaynı. Ortalama gerilme (σ_m) ve Alternatif gerilme (σ_a) koordinat sisteminde çizilir.
When a beam is bent, compressive stress occurs in its upper fibers, and tensile stress in its lower fibers. Stress is zero on the neutral axis.
Wide flange European standard H profile dimensions (light series).
Wide flange European standard H profile dimensions (normal series). Thicker and heavier than the HEA series, offers higher load-bearing capacity.
Yaygin rulman tipleri ve uygulama alanlari. Sabit bilyali, acisal temasli, silindirik makarali, konik makarali, igne makarali ve eksenel bilyali rulman tipleri mevcuttur.
